subject: Novus Retail: reported gap in generated responses — investigation & guidance
messages:
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@novus-retail.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-08 09:12 AM PST
Subject: Missing sections in product descriptions generated by Redwood API

Hi Markus,

We're seeing a recurring issue where our product description generator sometimes returns truncated or missing bullet sections for certain SKUs. Example attached (novus_sample_request.json). This started after we bumped to model v2.1 last week. It's intermittent — maybe 1-2% of requests — but it affects search and UX.

Can your team confirm whether this is a platform-side truncation, or something on our prompt/SDK? We capture the prompt and request id in the attached file.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Kim
Engineering Manager, Data & ML
Novus Retail

-----
Attachment: novus_sample_request.json (application/json)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@novus-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-08 11:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Missing sections in product descriptions generated by Redwood API

Hi Daniel — thanks for the report and the sample. I pulled the request id and forwarded the payload to our investigations team. Quick notes:

- We ran a first-pass repro against the same model variant (v2.1) and the same sequence length. Could not reproduce the missing bullets in repeated calls using the exact prompt and the provided request id.
- No platform-wide deploys or kernel changes were recorded around the timeframe you shared.
- We asked for your full request headers (SDK version, timeout, and any client-side streaming usage) and the raw response body when you observed the gap.

Next steps: Marissa from Support will take the lead on a deeper reproduction attempt and correlate logs across the infra path. If we still can't reproduce, we'll share a set of mitigation checks you can run client-side (SDK upgrades, deterministic temperature/seed, longer timeouts). Can you attach the three latest request ids where you saw the issue?

We aim to get back with a definitive finding by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@novus-retail.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-09 14:20 PM PST
Subject: Re: Missing sections in product descriptions generated by Redwood API

Hi Daniel — I'm Marissa on Support, looping in the repro notes below. Thanks for the example payload. Repro attempts summary:

- Method: repeated runs (50x) using the exact prompt and model v2.1 across identical seq len and request params. We exercised both our hosted edge and a dedicated node in us-west-2.
- Observation: 0/50 runs produced the specific bullet-gap you attached. Several responses had small token-level variance (expected), but structure intact.
- Logs: we pulled server side response sizes, latency, and token counts for your request ids. All returned token counts consistent with successful completions; no early termination flags.
- Client-side indicators: your sample shows a client timeout of 1200ms and a retry wrapper that cancels on first 2xx partial stream events. If the client hits a local timeout and drops the connection it will appear truncated in your app even though the server completed the output.

Attached: repro-logs-20280309.txt (sanitized). We recommend: 1) increase client timeout to 5s for these generation endpoints while we continue to monitor; 2) ensure streaming handlers don't cancel on partial frames; 3) pin SDK to >=1.8.2 which includes a fix for premature stream cancellation.

If after those changes you still see gaps, please share another request id and we will re-open a deeper trace with the runtime team (kernel and KV cache trace). Happy to do a 30min debug call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Support Engineer, Redwood Inference

-----
Attachment: repro-logs-20280309.txt (text/plain)
From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@novus-retail.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-10 16:45 PM PST
Subject: Novus Retail: follow-up — no platform issue confirmed (recommendations)

Daniel — quick follow-up after the repro window and log review. Summary:

- Finding: Our investigation did not identify a platform-side truncation or runtime error correlated to the request ids provided. Server-side token counts, completion status, and edge logs indicate full completions for the samples we traced.
- Most likely cause: client-side timeouts and streaming cancellation combined with prompt variations that produce variable-length sections.

Actionable recommendations we executed and validated with you:
1) Increase client request timeout to 5s for the generator endpoint and remove early cancellation on partial stream frames. We validated this behavior reproduces the full output in our internal tests.
2) Pin SDK to v1.8.2+ (contains streaming cancellation fix) — Marissa confirmed your team is updating this week.
3) Add a small post-processing guard: if expected section tokens are missing, retry once with temperature=0 and an explicit max_tokens bump of +60. This reduces variance for structured enumerations.

Closure note: We're closing this investigation on the platform side since no infra fault was found. If you apply the recommendations and still observe gaps, please reopen the ticket with a fresh request id and we will escalate to runtime tracing (kernel-level).

I'll also schedule a short 30-minute call next week to walk through mitigation steps and look at your SDK usage patterns. Is Wednesday 2028-03-14 10:00 AM PST good?

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
